about: What each screen part draws, as the browser and the story checks name it: its accessibility role, and the props that name it, first non-empty wins. A part a reader reads draws the role `text`: the registry marks it data-part="text", and a story's text line is counted among those marked parts by their text; a part that draws no role a story can see is null. Every part in catalog.ts has a line here, and a part added during a run adds its own (#1491).
